linkedin:
Move the server closer to them.

Serving Saudi users from a Europe region puts a physics floor of roughly 90 to 130 ms on every round trip, and that compounds across a page full of requests. Hosting in the in-Kingdom Dammam region (Google Cloud's `me-central2`) drops that into the single digits to low tens for users near Riyadh. A CDN speeds up static files, but only a closer origin speeds up dynamic, logged-in traffic.
